lede: Thrive is a weekend for women sixteen and older to step out of the rush, open the Word together, and remember who God is. Two old Hebrew words shape everything we’re building toward:

words.name: Yirah
words.text: Reverent wonder. The kind of awe that stops you, puts things back in proportion, and reminds you that God is bigger than whatever has been taking up all your attention.

words.name: Anag
words.text: To take real pleasure in something. Not a feeling we work up, but what happens when we see how good God is and how he delights in us, too.

verse: Take delight in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
